class.name: TweensGdKeyframeCurve
class.brief_description: Immutable prepared percentage-key curve shared by independent plays.
class.description: Supports numeric, vector, Rect2, Color, and Quaternion keys. Smooth uses limited modified-Akima tangents; quaternion Smooth falls back to spherical segments. Whole-color keys default to premultiplied OKLab with ordinary sRGB Godot Color input and straight-alpha output. Exact color keys preserve hidden RGB. Used by TweensGdKeyframes.

method.name: create
method.description: Copies strictly increasing percentage stops in [code][0, 100][/code] and prepares values and tangents. Native interpolation modes: Smooth=0, Linear=1, Step=2; these differ from the public Tweens.Interpolation constants. Arriving modes: -1 uses the curve default, 0 is Smooth, 1 is Linear, 2 is Step, and 3 uses the matching eases entry; zero-percent keys require -1. Color space: OKLab=0, sRGB=1, linear RGB=2; alpha: premultiplied=0, straight=1; encoding: sRGB=0, linear RGB=1. Mixed numeric keys use the first key's type; integer conversion rounds ties away from zero and saturates. Quaternion squared lengths must be finite and nonzero. Missing final keys hold. Inspect [member error] before use.

method.name: capture_start
method.description: Returns this curve if zero is explicit, or a separately prepared curve with a captured zero-percent key.

method.name: needs_start
method.description: True when zero is missing and a starting value must be captured before sampling.

method.name: sample
method.description: Samples normalized eased progress. Lookup is independent of previous samples. Outside [code][0, 1][/code], non-step segments extrapolate endpoint tangents; step segments and implicit final holds retain their endpoint. Returns null for invalid data, progress whose percentage is nonfinite, or a missing captured start.

members.member: Definition validation error, empty for a valid prepared curve.
